title: Consistent Sentinel map photomosaic
attribution: EOxCloudless https://cloudless.eox.at by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025)
hosting: EOX::Maps and bundled immutable map tiles
processing: Only resize and encode the same pinned map pixels; no recoloring.

features.encoding: RGBA8, unflipped top-first rows. First texel: mean R,G,B and twice luminance standard deviation. Second texel: mean luminance TL,TR,BL,BR. All channels 0..255; luminance uses Rec.709 weights 0.2126,0.7152,0.0722.

lookup.encoding: RGBA8: patchIndex = red + green * 256; blue = 0; alpha = 255
lookup.coordinates: x = redBin + blueBin * size; y = variant * size + greenBin
lookup.matching: Nearest mean color in weighted OKLab (lightness 1.35). Up to 8 distinct close matches, squared distance no more than best+0.0020. No pixel recoloring.
